segments.md:
# 50 Birds — a field guide with a quiz, and the teaching app for `location` + `waypoint`

Every value in this program lives in exactly one of three homes, sorted by the
stranger test (guide ch. 13 — *would you hand it to a stranger?*):

  location  the ADDRESSES — "" (the shelf), "b/<slug>" (one bird's page,
            crawlable and shareable), "quiz" (the quiz room). The URL shows
            these and nothing else.
  waypoint  the STEP — one string, "<seeds>|<answers>|<shown>", from which
            the entire quiz round derives: which ten birds, what you answered,
            which card is up, even the decoy choices (deterministic — no stored
            shuffle). Every pick and every Next writes it, so each is a history
            entry: the Back button retraces the quiz action by action, the URL
            sitting motionless at #quiz the whole time. A coordinate rides on
            its entry, so it comes back by TRAVERSAL only: reload the page (or
            open a shared #quiz link) and you get the invitation and a fresh
            round, because the URL is all an arrival has to rebuild from — one
            Back, though, and the old round is still on the entry behind you.
  ordinary  everything else — hovers, the loaded flag, and the FLIGHTS (the
            plate's zoom from shelf tile to page, and its return home —
            LZPix-style). The flights are the third row made vivid: nobody
            shares a zoom, so their rects are plain attributes and history
            never hears of them. Arrivals animate only from gestures — a
            pasted URL simply IS its page — but the journey HOME plays for
            the Back button too, armed inside `onFollow`: the hook is the one
            door a link click and a traversal both pass through, which is
            exactly what lets a motion answer Back without any handler running.

Around those three: every tile and cross-reference is a `link` (a real <a> —
hover preview, ⌘-click, the crawler's edge), so the crawl walks the shelf to
all fifty pages with no route table and no server; `onFollow` is the
renamed-pages door — Audubon's own names ("carolina-parrot",
"great-footed-hawk") redirect to today's slugs, so a 150-year-old citation
still lands; and `appName` derives per place, so the history menu lists real
titles. The plates are Audubon's, public domain; the data is a build-time
fixture (birds.json beside this file), which is what makes the whole guide
crawlable from a static host.

segments.html:
font Serif [ family = "Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif" ]

// ── palette: paper #F7F3E8 · panel #FFFDF6 · ink #2B2825 · muted #8A8272
//    hair #E2DACA · accent (oxblood) #7A3B2E · right #4A6B4D · wrong #9A4632

// ── one plate in a frame: cream mat, hairline, the engraving contained ───────

class Plate extends View [ fill = #FFFDF6, stroke = stroke(1, #E2DACA), clip = true,
    slug: string = "",
    lift: number = 0,                            // 0 = at rest, 1 = raised (hover) — the shadow deepens, LZPix-style
    shadow = { shadow(0, 2 + 5 * this.lift, 9 + 13 * this.lift, 0x00000024) },
    pic: Image [ x = 8, y = 8, width = { parent.width - 16 }, height = { parent.height - 16 },
        stretches = contain, source = { classroot.slug == "" ? "" : "plates/" + classroot.slug + ".jpg" } ]
    ]


// ── a shelf tile: plate + caption, the whole thing one LINK to the bird ──────

class Tile extends View [ width = { app.tileW }, height = { app.tileW + 44 },
    link = { "#b/" + :slug },
    x = { (:gi % app.cols) * (app.tileW + 18) },
    y = { (Math.floor(:gi / app.cols)) * (app.tileW + 62) },
    hoverT: number = 0,
    Spring [ attribute = hoverT, to = { classroot.hovered ? 1 : 0 }, stiffness = 220, damping = 20, epsilon = 0.001 ],

    // the click CAPTURES this plate's place on the shelf before the link
    // navigates (onClick beside a link runs first) — the flight's origin

    onClick() { app.beginFlight(this.frame, Number(:i)) },

    // while this bird is flying home its plate is simply NOT HERE — bare paper
    // and a caption waiting for it (app.inFlight). The flyer wears the same mat
    // and lands on this exact rect, so the swap at touchdown is invisible.

    frame: Plate [ width = { parent.width }, height = { parent.width }, slug = { :slug },
        visible = { !app.inFlight("" + :slug) },
        lift = { classroot.hoverT },
        scale = { 1 + 0.03 * classroot.hoverT }, pivotX = { this.width / 2 }, pivotY = { this.height / 2 } ],
    cap: Text [ y = { parent.width + 8 }, width = { parent.width }, textAlign = center, wrap = false,
        fontSize = 13, textColor = { classroot.hovered ? 0x7A3B2E : 0x2B2825 }, text = { :name } ],
    lost: Text [ y = { parent.width + 26 }, width = { parent.width }, textAlign = center, wrap = false,
        fontSize = 11, textColor = #9A4632, visible = { :status == "extinct" }, text = "extinct" ]
    ]


// ── one answer choice in the quiz ────────────────────────────────────────────

class Choice extends View [ width = { parent.width }, height = 44, cornerRadius = 8,
    pick: number = -1,                           // the bird index this button answers with
    label: string = "",
    state: string = "",                          // "" | "right" | "wrong" | "missed"
    fill = { this.state == "right" ? 0xDCE8DC : this.state == "wrong" ? 0xEFDCD6 : this.hovered ? 0xF2EDE0 : 0xFFFDF6 },
    stroke = { stroke(1, this.state == "right" ? 0x4A6B4D : this.state == "wrong" ? 0x9A4632 : 0xE2DACA) },
    onClick() { app.pick(this.pick) },
    t: Text [ x = 16, y = center, fontSize = 15, fontFamily = Serif,
        textColor = { parent.state == "wrong" ? 0x9A4632 : 0x2B2825 }, text = { classroot.label } ]
    ]


// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

App [ width = { app.hostWidth > 0 ? app.hostWidth : 1200 }, fill = #F7F3E8, textColor = #2B2825,
    location = "",
    waypoint = "",
    appName = { app.bird != null ? "" + app.bird.name + " · 50 Birds" : app.dest == "quiz" ? "The Quiz · 50 Birds" : "50 Birds" },

segments.md:
ENVIRONMENT-AWARE, the calendar's idiom: standalone the fixture sits
beside the app; hosted, the embedder passes env.base (its own
transport's path to this app's home) and the same relative address
resolves through it — `auto` refetches when base lands after init.

segments.html:
data: DataSource [ auto = true, url = { ("" + (app.env.base || "")) + "birds.json" } ],
    birds: array = { data.loaded ? data.value.groups.flatMap((g) => g.birds) : [] },

    // ── location → the address, parsed (grammar: "" · "b/<slug>" · "quiz") ──

    dest:    string = { app.location.split("/")[0] },
    slug:    string = { app.location.slice(0, 2) == "b/" ? app.location.slice(2) : "" },
    bird:    object = { app.slug == "" ? null : (app.birds.find((b) => b.slug == app.slug) ?? null) },
    atShelf: boolean = { app.dest != "quiz" && app.bird == null },

    // Audubon's own names still resolve — the renamed-pages door (onFollow).
    // A 150-year-old citation lands on today's slug; everything else passes.

    onFollow(ref: string) -> string {
        const old = ({ "carolina-parrot": "carolina-parakeet", "great-footed-hawk": "peregrine-falcon",
            "mocking-bird": "northern-mockingbird", "white-headed-eagle": "bald-eagle" }) as any
        const renamed = ref.slice(0, 3) == "#b/" ? old[ref.slice(3)] : undefined
        // The RETURN flight is armed here, in the hook, and not in any click
        // handler — because the hook is the one door EVERY arrival passes
        // through, the Back button included, and Back runs no handler. One
        // condition covers both ways home: the "← the whole shelf" link and a
        // history traversal each announce themselves as an arrival at "#",
        // and if we are leaving a bird when that arrives, its plate flies
        // back to its tile (the inverse of beginFlight, derived from data
        // rather than a captured rect, so it lands on the RIGHT tile even if
        // prev/next walked us far from the bird we originally opened).
        if (ref == "#" && app.bird != null) app.armReturn()
        return renamed != undefined ? "#b/" + renamed : ref
        },

    // ── waypoint → the session, parsed ("<seeds>|<answers>|<shown>") ─────────
    // The whole round is a pure function of this one string: ten bird indices
    // drawn at start, the answers so far, and which card is up. The DECOYS
    // derive too — fixed co-prime offsets from the right answer, ordered by a
    // rotation the answer picks — so a restored waypoint rebuilds the exact
    // card, choices and all. Nothing about the round is stored anywhere else.

    seeds:    number[] = { app.waypoint.split("|")[0] == "" ? [] : app.waypoint.split("|")[0].split(",").map(Number) },
    answers:  number[] = { (app.waypoint.split("|")[1] ?? "") == "" ? [] : app.waypoint.split("|")[1].split(",").map(Number) },
    shown:    number   = { Number(app.waypoint.split("|")[2] ?? 0) },
    started:  boolean  = { app.seeds.length > 0 },
    finished: boolean  = { app.started && app.shown >= app.seeds.length },
    answer:   number   = { app.started && !app.finished ? app.seeds[app.shown] : -1 },
    picked:   number   = { app.answers.length > app.shown ? app.answers[app.shown] : -1 },
    revealed: boolean  = { app.picked >= 0 },
    score:    number   = { app.answers.filter((a, t) => a == app.seeds[t]).length },
    choices:  number[] = { app.answer < 0 ? [] : app.rotate([app.answer, (app.answer + 13) % 50, (app.answer + 27) % 50, (app.answer + 41) % 50], app.answer % 4) },
    rotate(a: number[], n: number) -> number[] { return a.slice(n).concat(a.slice(0, n)) },

    // the session's verbs — each one write, each one history entry

    startQuiz() {
        const drawn = [] as number[]
        while (drawn.length < 10) {
            const n = Math.floor(Math.random() * 50)
            if (drawn.indexOf(n) < 0) drawn.push(n)
        }
        app.waypoint = drawn.join(",") + "||0"
        },
    pick(n: number) {
        if (app.revealed || app.answer < 0) return
        app.waypoint = app.seeds.join(",") + "|" + app.answers.concat([n]).join(",") + "|" + app.shown
        },
    advance() {
        if (!app.revealed) return
        app.waypoint = app.seeds.join(",") + "|" + app.answers.join(",") + "|" + (app.shown + 1)
        },

    nameOf(n: number) -> string { return app.birds.length > n && n >= 0 ? "" + app.birds[n].name : "" },
    slugOf(n: number) -> string { return app.birds.length > n && n >= 0 ? "" + app.birds[n].slug : "" },

    // ── the FLIGHT — one plate traveling from its shelf tile to the page ─────
    // The LZPix move, and the desktop's own open-zoom: the SAME object leaves
    // its grid slot and lands as the page's plate, so the transition reads as
    // continuity, not replacement. Note what the flight is NOT: it is neither
    // an address nor a step. A pasted `#b/…` URL and a Back press both land
    // with no entrance — a URL should simply BE the page, and Back restores
    // where you were rather than re-performing the click that took you there.
    // So the captured rect lives in ordinary attributes (flyW < 0 = none),
    // and only a real click ever starts the animator.

    flyX: number = -1,                           // the tile plate's rect, in content coordinates
    flyY: number = -1,
    flyW: number = -1,
    lerp(a: number, b: number, t: number) -> number { return a + (b - a) * t },
    beginFlight(v: View, i: number) {
        let x = 0
        let y = 0
        let n = v
        while (n != null && n != app) { x += n.x || 0; y += n.y || 0; n = n.parent }
        app.flyX = x
        app.flyY = y
        app.flyW = v.width
        app.page.fly.start()
        },
    turnPage() {
        // a within-page turn (prev/next, a cross-reference): no shelf rect to
        // fly from, so the entrance is a plain dissolve on the same animator
        app.flyW = -1
        app.page.fly.start()
        },
    armReturn() {
        // the inverse journey (see onFollow): remember WHO is going home, and
        // fly. The flyer below derives both endpoints — the page's resting
        // plate and the bird's own tile — so nothing else needs capturing.
        app.retSlug = "" + app.bird.slug
        app.ret.start()
        },
    retSlug: string = "",
    retT:    number = 1,
    ret:     Animator [ attribute = retT, from = 0, to = 1, duration = 340, motion = cubicOut ],

    // ONE PLATE, ONE PLACE. While a bird is flying home its shelf slot is bare
    // paper — the plate is not in two places, it is in the air — so the eye
    // follows a single object into the gap it left. The tile asks this of every
    // plate it draws; at rest it is always false.

    inFlight(slug: string) -> boolean { return app.retT < 1 && app.retSlug == slug },
    tileRectOf(slug: string) -> object {
        // a tile's resting rect on the shelf, re-derived from the same
        // arithmetic the shelf lays out with — content coordinates, so the
        // flyer lands true at any scroll position
        const b = app.birds.find((x) => x.slug == slug)
        if (b == null || !app.data.loaded) return ({ x: 0, y: 0, w: 0 })
        let y = 84
        for (const g of app.data.value.groups) {
            if (g.name == b.group) break
            y += 34 + Math.ceil(Number(g.count) / app.cols) * (app.tileW + 62) + 34
        }
        y += 34 + Math.floor(Number(b.gi) / app.cols) * (app.tileW + 62)
        return ({ x: app.colX + (Number(b.gi) % app.cols) * (app.tileW + 18), y: y, w: app.tileW })
        },

    // ── responsive column ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    colW:  number = { Math.min(1060, app.width - 48) },
    colX:  number = { (app.width - app.colW) / 2 },
    cols:  number = { app.colW < 560 ? 2 : app.colW < 840 ? 3 : 5 },
    tileW: number = { (app.colW - (app.cols - 1) * 18) / app.cols },

    // ── fixed chrome: the masthead rides the window over the page scroll ─────

    bar: View [ ignoreScroll = true, x = 0, y = 0, width = { app.width }, height = 58, fill = #F7F3E8F2,
        rule: View [ x = 0, y = 57, width = { parent.width }, height = 1, fill = #E2DACA ],
        mark: Text [ x = { app.colX }, y = center, fontFamily = Serif, fontSize = 19, letterSpacing = 2,
            text = "50 BIRDS", link = "#", textColor = #2B2825 ],
        sub: Text [ x = { app.colX + 118 }, y = 22, fontSize = 12, textColor = #8A8272, wrap = false,
            visible = { app.colW >= 700 }, text = "the plates of John James Audubon, 1827–1838" ],
        quizLink: Text [ x = { app.colX + app.colW - 64 }, y = center, fontSize = 14, fontFamily = Serif,
            link = "#quiz", text = "The Quiz", textColor = { app.dest == "quiz" ? 0x7A3B2E : 0x2B2825 } ]
        ],

    // ═══ the SHELF — every plate, grouped; each tile a link (an address) ═════

    shelf: View [ x = { app.colX }, y = 84, width = { app.colW }, visible = { app.atShelf },
        datapath = { app.data.loaded ? app.data.value : null },
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 34 ],
        loadNote: Text [ fontSize = 14, textColor = #8A8272, visible = { !app.data.loaded },
            text = { app.data.failed ? "The field guide failed to load: " + app.data.error : "Fetching the plates…" } ],
        Section [ datapath = :groups[], key = :name ],
        credit: Text [ width = { parent.width }, fontSize = 12, textColor = #8A8272, lineHeight = 1.5,
            text = "Plates: John James Audubon, The Birds of America (1827–1838), public domain — high-resolution scans courtesy of the National Audubon Society. Prose written for this field guide." ],
        pad: View [ width = 1, height = 56 ]
        ],

    // ═══ one BIRD — a page with an address you could hand to anyone ══════════

    page: View [ x = { app.colX }, y = 84, width = { app.colW }, visible = { app.bird != null },
        datapath = { app.bird },

        // the arrival scalar: 0 = just left the shelf, 1 = at rest. A clicked
        // tile flies the plate here (geometry below); a page turn dissolves;
        // a deep link or a traversal never starts it, so flyT RESTS at 1 and
        // the page is simply present — the entrance belongs to the gesture
        // that caused it, never to the URL or the Back button.

        flyT: number = 1,
        fly: Animator [ attribute = flyT, from = 0, to = 1, duration = 340, motion = cubicOut ],
        wide: boolean = { app.colW >= 760 },
        plateW: number = { this.wide ? Math.min(560, app.colW - 380) : app.colW },

        // the traveling object: from the captured tile rect (in page-local
        // terms) to the resting frame — or already at rest when no flight

        frame: Plate [
            x = { app.flyW < 0 ? 0 : app.lerp(app.flyX - app.colX, 0, parent.flyT) },
            y = { app.flyW < 0 ? 0 : app.lerp(app.flyY - 84, 0, parent.flyT) },
            width = { app.flyW < 0 ? parent.plateW : app.lerp(app.flyW, parent.plateW, parent.flyT) },
            height = { this.width * 1.05 },
            opacity = { app.flyW < 0 ? parent.flyT : 1 },
            slug = { "" + (:slug ?? "") } ],
        info: View [ x = { parent.wide ? parent.plateW + 36 : 0 }, y = { parent.wide ? 8 : parent.plateW * 1.05 + 24 },
            width = { parent.wide ? parent.width - parent.plateW - 36 : parent.width },
            opacity = { parent.flyT },               // the details fade up as the plate lands
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 14 ],
            name: Text [ fontFamily = Serif, fontSize = 30, width = { parent.width }, text = { "" + (:name ?? "") } ],
            latin: Text [ fontSize = 15, textColor = #8A8272, italic = true, text = { "" + (:latin ?? "") } ],
            plateNo: Text [ fontSize = 13, textColor = #8A8272,
                text = { :plate == null ? "" : "Plate " + :plate + (:audubonName != :name ? "  ·  Audubon called it the " + :audubonName : "") } ],
            gone: Text [ fontSize = 13, textColor = #9A4632, visible = { :status == "extinct" }, text = "EXTINCT" ],
            prose: Text [ width = { parent.width }, fontSize = 16, fontFamily = Serif, lineHeight = 1.55, text = { "" + (:prose ?? "") } ],
            kinHead: Text [ fontSize = 13, textColor = #8A8272, text = "SEE ALSO" ],
            kinRow: View [ width = { parent.width }, height = 24,
                layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 18 ],
                k1: Text [ fontSize = 14, fontFamily = Serif, textColor = #7A3B2E, wrap = false,
                    onClick() { app.turnPage() },
                    link = { "#b/" + :kin[0] }, text = { app.birds.length > 0 ? "" + (app.birds.find((b) => b.slug == :kin[0])?.name ?? "") : "" }
                    ],
                k2: Text [ fontSize = 14, fontFamily = Serif, textColor = #7A3B2E, wrap = false,
                    onClick() { app.turnPage() },
                    link = { "#b/" + :kin[1] }, text = { app.birds.length > 0 ? "" + (app.birds.find((b) => b.slug == :kin[1])?.name ?? "") : "" }
                    ]
                ],
            walk: View [ width = { parent.width }, height = 30,
                prev: Text [ x = 0, y = center, fontSize = 14, textColor = #8A8272, wrap = false,
                    onClick() { app.turnPage() },
                    visible = { :i > 0 }, link = { "#b/" + app.slugOf(:i - 1) }, text = { "← " + app.nameOf(:i - 1) }
                    ],
                next: Text [ x = { parent.width - this.width }, y = center, fontSize = 14, textColor = #8A8272, wrap = false,
                    onClick() { app.turnPage() },
                    visible = { :i < 49 }, link = { "#b/" + app.slugOf(:i + 1) }, text = { app.nameOf(:i + 1) + " →" }
                    ]
                ],
            home: Text [ fontSize = 14, textColor = #8A8272, link = "#", text = "← the whole shelf" ],
            pad: View [ width = 1, height = 56 ]
            ],
        platePad: View [ x = 0, y = { parent.plateW * 1.05 }, width = 1, height = 72 ]
        ],

    // ═══ the QUIZ — one address, a whole SESSION of history entries ══════════

    quiz: View [ shows = "quiz", x = { app.colX }, y = 84, width = { Math.min(620, app.colW) },
        card: View [ width = { parent.width },
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 16 ],

            // before a round: the invitation (also where a SHARED #quiz link
            // lands — the URL carried the place, deliberately not the session)

            invite: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { !app.started },
                layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 14 ],
                h: Text [ fontFamily = Serif, fontSize = 26, text = "Name the bird." ],
                p: Text [ width = { parent.width }, fontSize = 15, lineHeight = 1.5, textColor = #8A8272,
                    text = "Ten plates, four names each. The Back button un-asks a question — try it mid-round and watch the URL not care." ],
                go: View [ width = 180, height = 44, cornerRadius = 8, fill = #7A3B2E,
                    onClick() { app.startQuiz() },
                    t: Text [ y = center, width = { parent.width }, textAlign = center, fontFamily = Serif,
                        fontSize = 16, textColor = #F7F3E8, text = "Begin" ]
                    ]
                ],

            // the live card — everything on it derives from app.waypoint

            live: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { app.started && !app.finished },
                shownT: number = 0,
                Spring [ attribute = shownT, to = { app.shown }, stiffness = 190, damping = 24, epsilon = 0.002 ],
                x = { (app.shown - this.shownT) * -42 },
                opacity = { 1 - Math.min(1, Math.abs(app.shown - this.shownT)) * 0.55 },
                layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 14 ],
                tally: Text [ fontSize = 13, textColor = #8A8272,
                    text = { "Question " + (app.shown + 1) + " of " + app.seeds.length + "   ·   " + app.score + " right so far" } ],
                frame: Plate [ width = { Math.min(440, parent.width) }, height = { Math.min(440, parent.width) * 0.9 },
                    slug = { app.revealed ? app.slugOf(app.answer) : app.slugOf(app.answer) } ],
                c0: Choice [ pick = { app.choices[0] ?? -1 }, label = { app.nameOf(app.choices[0] ?? -1) },
                    state = { !app.revealed ? "" : (app.choices[0] == app.answer ? "right" : (app.choices[0] == app.picked ? "wrong" : "")) } ],
                c1: Choice [ pick = { app.choices[1] ?? -1 }, label = { app.nameOf(app.choices[1] ?? -1) },
                    state = { !app.revealed ? "" : (app.choices[1] == app.answer ? "right" : (app.choices[1] == app.picked ? "wrong" : "")) } ],
                c2: Choice [ pick = { app.choices[2] ?? -1 }, label = { app.nameOf(app.choices[2] ?? -1) },
                    state = { !app.revealed ? "" : (app.choices[2] == app.answer ? "right" : (app.choices[2] == app.picked ? "wrong" : "")) } ],
                c3: Choice [ pick = { app.choices[3] ?? -1 }, label = { app.nameOf(app.choices[3] ?? -1) },
                    state = { !app.revealed ? "" : (app.choices[3] == app.answer ? "right" : (app.choices[3] == app.picked ? "wrong" : "")) } ],
                verdict: View [ width = { parent.width }, height = 44, visible = { app.revealed },
                    v: Text [ x = 0, y = center, fontFamily = Serif, fontSize = 16,
                        textColor = { app.picked == app.answer ? 0x4A6B4D : 0x9A4632 },
                        text = { app.picked == app.answer ? "Yes — the " + app.nameOf(app.answer) + "." : "No — that's the " + app.nameOf(app.answer) + "." } ],
                    onward: View [ x = { parent.width - 130 }, width = 130, height = 40, cornerRadius = 8, fill = #7A3B2E,
                        onClick() { app.advance() },
                        t: Text [ y = center, width = { parent.width }, textAlign = center, fontSize = 14,
                            textColor = #F7F3E8, text = { app.shown + 1 >= app.seeds.length ? "The tally →" : "Next plate →" } ]
                        ]
                    ]
                ],

            // the round, finished: the tally and the walk back through it

            done: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { app.finished },
                layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 14 ],
                h: Text [ fontFamily = Serif, fontSize = 26, text = { app.score + " of " + app.seeds.length } ],
                p: Text [ width = { parent.width }, fontSize = 15, lineHeight = 1.5, textColor = #8A8272,
                    text = "Hold Back and the whole round unwinds, answer by answer — ten entries, one URL. Each bird below is an address; the round never was." ],
                r0: Recap [ t = 0 ],
                r1: Recap [ t = 1 ],
                r2: Recap [ t = 2 ],
                r3: Recap [ t = 3 ],
                r4: Recap [ t = 4 ],
                r5: Recap [ t = 5 ],
                r6: Recap [ t = 6 ],
                r7: Recap [ t = 7 ],
                r8: Recap [ t = 8 ],
                r9: Recap [ t = 9 ],
                again: View [ width = 180, height = 44, cornerRadius = 8, fill = #7A3B2E,
                    onClick() { app.startQuiz() },
                    t: Text [ y = center, width = { parent.width }, textAlign = center, fontFamily = Serif,
                        fontSize = 16, textColor = #F7F3E8, text = "Another ten" ]
                    ]
                ],
            pad: View [ width = 1, height = 72 ]
            ]
        ],

    // the RETURN flyer — the same plate, traveling home (declared last, so it
    // paints above the shelf it lands on). An overlay rather than the page's
    // frame, because the page has already yielded to the shelf by the time the
    // return runs; at rest (retT = 1) it does not exist.

    flyer: Plate [ visible = { app.retT < 1 },
        slug = { app.retSlug },
        x = { app.lerp(app.colX, app.tileRectOf(app.retSlug).x, app.retT) },
        y = { app.lerp(84, app.tileRectOf(app.retSlug).y, app.retT) },
        width = { app.lerp(app.page.plateW, app.tileRectOf(app.retSlug).w, app.retT) },
        height = { this.width * app.lerp(1.05, 1, app.retT) } ]
    ]


// ── a shelf section: group header + its tiles on a grid ──────────────────────

class Section extends View [ width = { parent.width },
    group: string = { "" + :name },
    n: number = { Number(:count) },
    height = { 34 + Math.ceil(this.n / app.cols) * (app.tileW + 62) },
    head: Text [ fontFamily = Serif, fontSize = 17, letterSpacing = 1, textColor = #8A8272,
        text = { classroot.group.toUpperCase() } ],
    grid: View [ y = 34, width = { parent.width },
        Tile [ datapath = :birds[], key = :slug ]
        ]
    ]


// ── one line of the quiz recap: plate number, the bird (a link), your call ───

class Recap extends View [ width = { parent.width }, height = 26,
    t: number = 0,
    ok: boolean = { app.answers[this.t] == app.seeds[this.t] },
    mark: Text [ x = 0, y = center, fontSize = 14, textColor = { classroot.ok ? 0x4A6B4D : 0x9A4632 },
        text = { classroot.ok ? "✓" : "✗" } ],
    who: Text [ x = 26, y = center, fontSize = 14, fontFamily = Serif, textColor = #7A3B2E, wrap = false,
        link = { "#b/" + app.slugOf(app.seeds[classroot.t] ?? -1) }, text = { app.nameOf(app.seeds[classroot.t] ?? -1) } ],
    call: Text [ x = 300, y = center, fontSize = 13, textColor = #8A8272, wrap = false,
        visible = { !classroot.ok }, text = { "you said " + app.nameOf(app.answers[classroot.t] ?? -1) } ]
    ]
